summary: Frontend-only verification of the 5 new Norte program pages + hub-card wiring + Hero spacing + MoroccoVideos rail + SectionGallery (Sur/Norte/Marruecos/Escapadas) + ES/EN/FR i18n + lightweight backend smoke. 12/12 functional UI assertions pass. Two issues surfaced: (1) the Norte program heroes use an Unsplash photo of the Taj Mahal (India) as the hero background — geographically wrong; (2) React 'two children with the same key' console errors fire on every program page render.

minor.issue: PRD references /api/contact with field 'name', but the actual implemented endpoint is /api/contact-requests with field 'full_name'. POST to /api/contact-requests with {full_name,email,message,language} returns 200 OK and persists. Frontend appears to use the correct endpoint — only PRD/spec drift.

Returns 200 OK but response shape is {source, fetched_at, reference_month, zones:{atlas:{day,night,samples}, sahara:{day,night,samples}}}, not the PRD-stated {avg,min,max}. Functionally OK, schema mismatch with spec.

ui_bugs.component: Norte program heroes (ciudadesImperialesRif67, fezTanger67, tangerFez4567, fezTanger56)
ui_bugs.issue: Hero background image is the Taj Mahal (Unsplash photo-1548013146-72479768bada). Geographically wrong for a Morocco tour and breaks brand promise. The page renders correctly with the right title overlay ('Cités impériales et Rif.', 'Fez – Asilah – Tánger.', etc.) but the visual is India, not Morocco. Same class of mistake as iteration_4 (Burj Al Arab on Atlas/Desierto hub).

React fires repeated 'Encountered two children with the same key' warnings (keys 1,2,3,4,5,6) on every program-detail render. Suggests a list (likely day list or quick-info chip list) uses non-unique keys (probably key={item.day} where multiple subsections reuse the same index, or duplicate program.meta.es vs VARIANT_COPY items rendered side by side). Likely culprit in ProgramTemplate.jsx around the itinerary/quickInfo/seasons render or the merge of program.meta + VARIANT_COPY.

action_items: Replace the Taj Mahal Unsplash image (photo-1548013146-72479768bada) used as hero in /app/frontend/src/lib/programs/ciudadesImperialesRif67.js, fezTanger67.js, tangerFez45.js, tangerFez56.js, fezTanger56.js with an authentic Moroccan visual (Fez medina, Volubilis, Chefchaouen blue village, Tangier coast, Asilah ramparts). Photo-1597212618440-806262de4f6b also looks Indian/Mughal — verify too.

Fix the React duplicate-key warnings on program pages. Inspect ProgramTemplate.jsx around the meta merge (lines 816-820) and the itinerary / quickInfo / seasons map() blocks — most likely two arrays are rendered into the same parent (e.g., VARIANT_COPY days + program.meta days, or quickInfo chips key={index}) producing key collisions 1..6.

(Doc) Either rename backend endpoint /api/contact-requests → /api/contact or update the PRD line to match. Also reconcile the climate response schema (avg/min/max vs zones.atlas/sahara.day/night) with the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: ProgramTemplate.jsx merge of program.meta over VARIANT_COPY (line 816-820) does work — hero title comes from program.meta.es.title as designed — but the duplicate-key warnings on the same page suggest the merge or a downstream .map() is iterating two list sources with overlapping numeric keys. Use stable ids (e.g., `${variant}-day-${day.day}`) instead of `key={day}` or `key={index}`.

Image curation gap: 2 of 5 newly added Norte program files share the same Taj Mahal Unsplash URL. There is no central image registry — a `/lib/morocco-image-set.js` would prevent foreign-country placeholders from slipping into Morocco-only pages (cf. iteration_4 Burj Al Arab issue).

Tests for backend contact / climate exist (/app/backend/tests/test_contact_api.py) but PRD endpoint names drift; a one-line README mapping spec→implementation would prevent future testers re-hitting wrong URLs.

rca of the issue: Wrong hero image RCA: 5 new program data files were created in /app/frontend/src/lib/programs/ but the curator likely copy-pasted a generic 'oriental arch' Unsplash photo (1548013146-72479768bada) as the hero image without verifying the photo's actual location — it is the Taj Mahal in Agra, India. Same root cause as iteration_4's Burj Al Arab. Mitigation: maintain a curated Morocco-only image registry. // React key RCA: most likely the merge program.meta.es.quickInfo + VARIANT_COPY.quickInfo in ProgramTemplate.jsx (~line 816-820) produces a list where both sources contribute items with the same `key={i}` index, or the day list uses `key={day.day}` and some merged variant has duplicate day numbers. Look for the rendering loop fed by the merged structure and ensure keys are namespaced (e.g., `program-${id}-day-${day.day}` or `meta-${i}`).
